svg.title: MLLM Architecture, Multi-Head Attention Block, and Overall Gain from Our Method
svg.desc: Editable reconstruction of the original figure. Base frames: left MLLM architecture, central multi-head attention block with nested standard MHA, visual attention ratio, reasoning and perception layers, and right-side gain comparison grids plus legend. Directional conduction is top-to-bottom in the left stack, left-to-right and top-to-bottom through the attention block, then top-to-bottom on the right gain comparison. SAM mappings are retained for confirmed small icon/photo crops as overlay replacements while preserving native SVG construction, frames, labels, borders, arrows and uncovered content.
